- Plan uses tdd vertical cycles and improve-code-boundaries guidance.
- Added <plan> path to task 02.

- Per instruction, quit immediately after setting NOW EXECUTE; next run should execute this plan.

- Read previous progress and current task pointer.
- Previous plan is approved with NOW EXECUTE; reading task and plan to start implementation.
- Next: execute TDD vertical slices for project lint analyzers and keep task plan checkboxes updated.

- Started Cycle 1 RED for no-value-receivers.
- Added internal/projectlint/analyzers_test.go and value_receiver fixture expecting a diagnostic.
- Next: run focused test, then add minimal NoValueReceiversAnalyzer to make it pass.

- Cycle 1 complete: NoValueReceiversAnalyzer reports a value receiver through analysistest.
- Added internal/projectlint/analyzers.go with minimal AST walk and focused test is green.
- Next: add pointer receiver negative case, then implement explicit allow directives.

- Cycle 2 complete: pointer receiver negative case passes through the public analyzer test.
- Started Cycle 3 RED by adding an attached value-receiver allow directive fixture.
- Next: implement one shared directive helper for per-declaration exemptions.

- Cycle 3 complete: attached value-receiver allow directive suppresses only with a documented reason.
- Started Cycle 4 RED for no-struct-error-returns with BuildConfig returning (Config, error).
- Next: add type-aware NoStructErrorReturnsAnalyzer.

- Cycle 4 complete: NoStructErrorReturnsAnalyzer reports BuildConfig returning (Config, error).
- Adjusted analyzer test fixtures into separate packages per analyzer because analysistest consumes all want comments in a package.
- Next: add pointer return, non-struct return, struct-error allow directive, and generated-looking-file behavior.

- Cycles 5-8 complete: struct pointer return passes, named non-struct return passes, struct-error directive passes, generated-looking value receiver is still flagged.
- Next: add cmd/projectlint multichecker command and Makefile project-lint target.

- Cycle 9 complete: cmd/projectlint multichecker builds; go run against fixtures exits nonzero with expected value-receiver and struct-error diagnostics.
- Cycle 10 RED confirmed make project-lint had no rule before Makefile edit.
- Added PROJECT_LINT build rule and project-lint target; next run formatting and verification commands.

- Cycle 10 GREEN: make project-lint builds .bin/projectlint and runs it over ./...
- make project-lint currently fails with existing repository violations, as expected by the approved plan; output includes many value receivers and struct/error returns for later story tasks.
- Next: run normal repository tests/checks and record evidence artifacts.

- Raw go test ./... failed because envtest packages require KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS; this repo expects make test to set that up.
- Focused projectlint tests and cmd/projectlint tests pass.
- Next: run make test, then make check and make test-coverage if make test is green.

- make test passed with envtest via setup-envtest.
- Next: go mod tidy, then run full make check gate including lint/race/contract/e2e/large chaos/coverage.

- make check failed at golangci-lint for new analyzer issues: shadowed ok variables, nilnil returns, and missing package/export comments.
- Applied fixes without changing analyzer behavior: named type assertion booleans, non-nil empty analyzer result, package comments, export comments.
- Next: rerun focused tests and make check.

- Focused tests failed after nilnil fix because analyzers returned struct{} without declaring ResultType.
- Added reflect.TypeOf(emptyAnalyzerResult) as ResultType for both analyzers.
- The concurrent make check used the old binary/source before that patch and failed in projectlint tests; next rerun focused tests then make check.

- make check passed after ResultType fix; coverage total 86.0%, internal/projectlint 85.5%.
- Added RED command-boundary test for projectAnalyzers, then refactored cmd/projectlint main to build its analyzer set through projectAnalyzers.
- Next: rerun focused tests, make check, make test, and make test-coverage; then record evidence.

- Current-tree make check passed: lint/vet/tests/race/contract/e2e/large-chaos/coverage all green.
- Coverage from make check: cmd/projectlint 80.0%, internal/projectlint 85.5%, total 86.0%.
- Next: run explicit make test and make test-coverage, then capture evidence files and update task passes.

- Captured evidence files for focused analyzer tests, command tests, envtest-backed go test ./..., fixture lint failures, .bin/projectlint fixture failures, make project-lint current-repo findings, and new package coverage.
- Next: capture explicit make check/make test/make test-coverage evidence files, then update task metadata.

- Updated task file to status done and passes=true with evidence links and checked acceptance criteria.
- Updated plan execution status with all TDD cycles and final gates checked.
- Next: run .ralph/task_switch.sh, git add all files, commit with required message, push, then quit.
